/*
 * Burris Quality of Life - repair recipes.
 *
 * Vanilla's fixing.txt covers firearms only, so a broken Plunger or Nightstick
 * is simply dead weight. These two entries fill that gap.
 *
 * B42 format notes (the B41 syntax silently fails to parse):
 *   - keys use `=`, not `:`
 *   - item ids are fully qualified (Base.Foo), not bare
 *   - `Base.WoodenStick` does not exist in 42.20; it is `Base.WoodenStick2`
 */

module Base
{
    fixing Fix Plunger
    {
        Require = Base.Plunger,
        GlobalItem = Base.WoodenStick2=1,
        ConditionModifier = 1,
        Fixer = Base.Woodglue=1,
    }

    fixing Fix Nightstick
    {
        Require = Base.Nightstick,
        ConditionModifier = 1,
        Fixer = Base.Woodglue=1,
    }
}
